question: When the accepted D03 CAL24 PM retains its referenced one-hour subtask, does changing only PMLocation.PMT from one to four hours leave the observed PM work duration, recurrence and full 60-hour report ledger unchanged?

related_accepted_precedent.relationship: Its preserved task-referenced diagnostic had SCPMT2 but unchanged PM work and a report identical to D03; its accepted task-free pair tests a separate PMT fallback. Neither directly tests changing authored PMT while the subtask remains referenced.

source.manual_rule: Physical page 389 says PMLocation.PMT is overridden for PM actions split into subtasks; total duration is calculated from the subtasks.

source_delta.only_changed_cell: PMLocation row CAL24/TEACH-AIR-01/BASE-01 PMT 1 to 4 hours
retained: PMLocation.TID=PM-CAL24 and TaskBreakDown SEQ1 DURN=1 hour
one aircraft, fixed seed 1, one repetition and 60-hour horizon
three nonconflicting scheduled two-hour missions and all other 215 authored cell values
Control.ENPM=Y and all MISSION/SYSTEM half-hour result collection settings

predeclared_acceptance: Independent GO_CONTRACT_ONLY must precede child source creation; a separate frozen source, exact diff, roundtrip checker, runner, behavior checker and GO_PRELAUNCH must precede one native launch.

A single session-0 SSH run must hold Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, preserve GUI PID13340/session1/exact start/responding, use a unique empty run directory and seal success or failure without rerunning the accepted parent.

Import/export must preserve all 18 authored row-containing tables before calculation. Converter errors must be zero, warnings classified, and SXO, event log and report valid; a zero native exit alone is not a pass.

The conditional no-change hypothesis is PM starts at hours 24 and 49, one-hour subtask work and PM completion at 25 and 50, three successful missions at 10, 22 and 34, and no additional PM/failure/repair before hour 60.

Reconcile every field of all 120 half-hour SystemResults and StockTotalResults rows, event log, ResultSummary, PM starts/completions, ready/unavailable status and integrated PM aircraft-hours against accepted D03; treat exact equality as a falsifiable hypothesis until native replay.
limits: This tests one authored PMT value with one referenced one-hour task at one fixed seed and 60-hour horizon. It does not establish a general precedence rule across arbitrary subtasks, PMT values, PMTD distributions, resources, item demand or scale factors.
The three missions do not conflict with PM. GUI visual and cross-engine behavior remain unverified.
